faq.q: What is a titanium pacemaker enclosure?
faq.a: A titanium pacemaker enclosure is a precision-machined implantable device component used in permanent pacemaker outer hermetic enclosure. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What standards apply to titanium pacemaker enclosure?
faq.a: Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure is manufactured to ASTM F136 / ISO 5832-3 (Ti-6Al-4V ELI) or ASTM F1295 (Ti-6Al-7Nb) for medical implants. This requires oxygen <0.13%, iron <0.25%, and 100% traceability with MTC per batch.

faq.q: How is titanium pacemaker enclosure manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure is manufactured using VAR melting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium pacemaker enclosure?
faq.a: The most common issue is stress shielding from modulus mismatch between implant and bone. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium pacemaker enclosure?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
